evidence.title: Google Research Introduces ME-POIs: A Mobility-Informed Framework that Adds “How a Place Is Used” to Text-Based POI Embeddings

summary: Google Research unveiled ME-POIs, a mobility‑informed framework that incorporates information about how places are used into existing text‑based point‑of‑interest (POI) embeddings. The approach aims to improve location‑based AI models by blending textual descriptions with real‑world mobility patterns.
title: Google Research launches ME-POIs framework to enrich POI embeddings with mobility usage data
